summary: A sturdy, friendly retriever in black, yellow, or chocolate. One of the most commonly seen dogs on any walk.
traits: Broad head with kind, expressive eyes

name: Golden Retriever
summary: A friendly retriever with a feathered golden coat. Easy to confuse with a Goldendoodle at a distance.
traits: Dense, feathered coat in shades of gold
Feathering on chest, legs, and tail
Straight to wavy coat, never tightly curled
Broad head with a friendly expression

name: Brittany
summary: A compact, leggy bird dog, usually orange-and-white or liver-and-white, with endless energy.
traits: Orange/white or liver/white coat, often ticked or roan

name: American Cocker Spaniel
summary: The smallest member of the Sporting Group, the American Cocker Spaniel is a medium-sized sporting dog with a beautifully chiseled head, long flowing silky coat, long ears, and gentle expression

name: American Water Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized versatile sporting dog with distinctive curly or wavy chocolate or liver coat, bred for hunting waterfowl in the icy waters and marshy banks of the Great Lakes region

name: Ariège Pointer
summary: Medium to large, elegant and muscular French pointing dog with distinctive orange and white coat pattern and fine nose, known for its endurance, docile nature, and versatile hunting abilities

name: Barbet
summary: Medium-sized French water dog with distinctive long, dense, curly coat and webbed feet, bred for waterfowl retrieval. Known for its rustic, athletic build and joyful, intelligent disposition.

name: Blue Picardy Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized, strongly built gundog with distinctive blue-gray roan speckled coat that gives it a bluish appearance. Known for its gentle hunting temperament and versatile field abilities.

name: Boykin Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized, energetic, and versatile flushing and retrieving spaniel with rich liver or chocolate brown coat and enthusiastic work ethic, especially in water. Known for their amiable disposition and compact build ideal for hunting from small boats.

name: Bracco Italiano
summary: Large, noble Italian pointing breed with sculpted head, distinctive orange and white or chestnut and white coat, and pendulous ears. A powerful and athletic dog of ancient Italian lineage, known for its endurance and gentle, intelligent nature.

name: Braque d'Auvergne
summary: Medium-sized French pointing breed with distinctive black and white ticked coat marked with patches and speckles, noble head, and athletic build

name: Braque du Bourbonnais
summary: Ancient, medium-sized French pointing dog with compact, agile build, distinctive ticked speckled coat, naturally short tail, and expressive face. Known for natural hunting instincts and athletic ability.

name: Braque Français

name: Braque Saint-Germain
summary: Elegant and athletic medium-sized French pointing dog with distinctive white coat and orange markings, known for its gentle temperament and versatile hunting abilities

name: Burgos Pointer
summary: Large, robust Spanish pointing breed with distinctive white and liver coat, athletic build, and noble demeanor. Known for its calm temperament, droopy ears, and exceptional hunting prowess in varied terrain.

name: Cantabrian Water Dog
summary: A rustic, medium-sized, and athletic water dog from the Cantabria region of northern Spain, characterized by a curly, woolly, waterproof coat. Originally bred for fishing and water work, this ancient breed is known for its loyalty, work-focused nature, and exceptional aptitude for swimming and retrieving.

name: Český fousek
summary: Medium-sized, wire-haired versatile pointing dog of noble appearance with distinctive beard, known for endurance, adaptability, and devotion as a hunting companion

name: Chesapeake Bay Retriever
summary: A powerful, muscular gundog with distinctive wavy, waterproof double coat and amber eyes, bred for retrieving waterfowl in the harsh conditions of the Chesapeake Bay

name: Clumber Spaniel
summary: A long, low, and substantial flushing spaniel with a massive head, heavy bone structure, pensive expression, and predominantly white coat with lemon or orange markings

name: Cocker Spaniel
summary: Compact sporting breed with silky coat, merry expression, and affectionate nature

name: Curly-Coated Retriever
summary: Large, elegant retriever and one of the oldest retriever breeds, distinguished by its distinctive tight, water-resistant curly coat and confident, athletic temperament

name: Drentse Patrijshond
summary: Medium-sized versatile hunting dog from the Netherlands with distinctive white coat and orange/brown markings, known for pointing and retrieving abilities. This intelligent spaniel-type breed serves as both an excellent gundog and devoted family companion.

name: English Cocker Spaniel
summary: A medium-sized, merry sporting spaniel known for its silky coat, long lush ears, expressive eyes, and energetic attitude. Compact and athletic, built for endurance and agility in the field with exceptional abilities as both hunting companion and family dog.

name: English Setter
summary: Elegant and athletic gundog distinguished by its unique speckled (belton) coat, feathered markings, and graceful movement, known for gentle hunting instincts and friendly disposition

name: English Springer Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized athletic sporting dog with long ears, feathered silky coat, and enthusiastic, eager-to-please personality. Known for their compact body, gentle intelligent expression, and versatile gundog abilities.

name: Field Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized sporting dog with silky, glossy coat in black, liver, or roan colors, built for endurance and agility in the field with an adaptable, noble temperament

name: Flat-Coated Retriever
summary: Large, elegant sporting dog with a lustrous, sleek flat coat in solid black or liver, known for their cheerful, perpetually youthful 'Peter Pan' personality and optimistic temperament

name: French Spaniel
summary: Medium to large versatile pointing dog with elegant silky brown and white coat and gentle expression, known for hunting ability and calm temperament. One of the oldest spaniel-type pointing breeds.

name: German Longhaired Pointer
summary: Noble, versatile medium to large gundog with elegant build and distinctive long, silky, weather-resistant coat with feathering. Developed as an all-purpose German hunting breed known for calm intelligence and athletic ability.

name: German Roughhaired Pointer
summary: Medium to large versatile gundog with dense, harsh, bristly (stichelhaarig) weatherproof coat and distinctive beard. Known for strong pointing instincts and calm, even temperament, this noble hunting companion is considered the oldest of the German rough-coated pointing breeds.

name: German Shorthaired Pointer
summary: A versatile, athletic, and noble all-purpose hunting dog with a distinctive short, dense liver and white coat, known for its intelligence, energy, and friendly disposition

name: German Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized, muscular hunting spaniel known as the Deutscher Wachtelhund in its native Germany, with a dense wavy double coat featuring feathering and strong tracking abilities developed for versatile forest hunting

name: German Wirehaired Pointer
summary: Medium to large versatile hunting dog with distinctive dense wiry double coat, bushy beard, and facial furnishings, known for endurance and weather resistance

name: Gordon Setter
summary: Large, athletic bird dog with distinctive glistening black-and-tan coat. Built sturdily for work in rugged terrain, it is the heaviest and most substantial of the setter breeds, known for endurance and loyalty with an alert expression.

name: Irish Red and White Setter
summary: Medium to large athletic gundog with distinctive red and white coat pattern and aristocratic appearance. This versatile sporting breed combines a powerful, athletic build with a kind expression and was bred specifically for pointing and retrieving game birds.

name: Irish Setter
summary: Elegant, athletic gundog known for its stunning mahogany or rich chestnut red flowing coat and high-energy, friendly temperament

name: Irish Water Spaniel
summary: The tallest of all spaniels, this large, versatile sporting dog is distinguished by its crisp, curly purplish-brown waterproof coat, distinctive smooth tapered 'rat tail', and characteristic topknot. Bred for retrieving waterfowl from cold Irish waters, combining intelligence with a playful, alert nature.

name: Kooikerhondje
summary: Small, agile spaniel-type dog of Dutch origin with a distinctive flowing orange-red and white particolored coat and feathered ears, originally bred for luring ducks into traps

name: Lagotto Romagnolo
summary: Medium-sized rustic water retriever with dense, curly, waterproof coat and exceptional sense of smell, specialized as the world's premier truffle-hunting dog

name: Large Münsterländer
summary: Versatile medium to large German pointing and retrieving dog with distinctive black and white coat and feathering, known for its noble appearance and athletic build

name: Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever
summary: The smallest of the retrievers, this medium-sized, athletic sporting dog is known for its distinctive reddish coat with white markings and enthusiastic personality. Originally bred for luring and retrieving waterfowl by playing along the shoreline.

name: Old Danish Pointer
summary: Medium to large, strongly-built pointer of noble appearance with distinctive white coat and brown markings, bred for endurance hunting in Danish terrain and known for its calm, stable temperament

name: Pachón Navarro
summary: Medium to large-sized, robust Spanish pointing dog with distinctive split or 'double' nose, renowned for its hunting abilities as a versatile and athletic worker. This resilient and tireless breed is a prized hunting companion with excellent scenting ability.

name: Perdigueiro Galego
summary: Medium-sized, noble Spanish pointing dog from the Galicia region with a refined build, short dense coat, and excellent hunting instincts. Known for its calm temperament and versatile abilities as an upland game retriever.

name: Picardy Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized, strongly-built French pointing dog with distinctive grey-mottled brown feathered coat, drop ears, and gentle, docile expression. This elegant gundog combines calm adaptability with natural hunting ability.

name: Pointer
summary: An athletic and graceful medium-large sporting dog renowned for its speed, stamina, and keen nose. Known for its characteristic pointing stance and aristocratic demeanor, the Pointer is a hard-driving hunting companion with exceptional field abilities.

name: Pont-Audemer Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized, rustic French water spaniel with distinctive curly, water-resistant coat, topknot, and gentle, clownish expression. Specialized for wetland game retrieval with excellent swimming abilities.

name: Portuguese Pointer
summary: A medium-sized, athletic gundog of noble appearance with short dense coat and expressive face, known for its extreme devotion to its master, excellent scenting ability, and dedicated, persistent hunting style

name: Pudelpointer
summary: Medium to large versatile hunting dog combining Poodle intelligence with Pointer field abilities, featuring a distinctive dense wiry coat and keen, energetic temperament bred for exceptional performance in both field and water

name: Russian Spaniel
summary: Small to medium-sized sporting dog with long, silky coat and feathered ears, known for its energetic, friendly nature. The only gundog breed developed in Russia, this sturdy flushing spaniel was created for hunting game birds in Russian terrain.

name: Saint-Usuge Spaniel
summary: A medium-sized, elegant, and robust French spaniel with a brown coat, known for its versatility as a pointing and retrieving gundog with a gentle and affectionate personality

name: Slovak Rough-haired Pointer
summary: A versatile and noble-looking medium-to-large gundog with harsh, wiry gray coat and muscular, athletic build. Distinguished by its endurance in the field and developed for pointing, tracking, and retrieving on land and in water.

name: Small Münsterländer
summary: Medium-sized versatile hunting dog of German origin with distinctive brown and white or brown roan feathered coat, known for excellent pointing and retrieving abilities and elegant appearance

name: Spinone Italiano
summary: Large, robust, and muscular hunting dog with a distinctive dense wiry coat, expressive beard and eyebrows, and patient gentle expression. Built for all-terrain hunting with a rugged yet versatile build and methodical hunting style.

name: Stabyhoun
summary: Medium-sized versatile Dutch pointing dog from Friesland with a distinctive sleek, longish black and white coat and gentle, calm temperament. One of the rarest breeds in the world and considered a Dutch national treasure.

name: Sussex Spaniel
summary: A long, low, and muscular spaniel with a distinctive rich golden liver coat and rolling gait, bred for hunting in dense undergrowth. Known for its calm and affectionate nature, this massive spaniel moves with deliberate purpose and steady temperament.

name: Tarsus Çatalburun
summary: A rare Turkish gundog known for its distinctive split nose and exceptional scenting abilities. This athletic hunting breed from the Tarsus region combines keen pointing skills with a unique congenital split nose believed to enhance scenting ability.

name: Vizsla
summary: Medium-sized, energetic and graceful gundog of Hungarian origin with a sleek, golden-rust colored coat and athletic build. Known for their affectionate, gentle nature, they are versatile hunters and eager companions with high energy drive.

name: Weimaraner
summary: Large, sleek, athletic sporting dog with distinctive silver-gray coat and striking amber or blue-gray eyes, known for speed, stamina, and intelligence. Originally bred for hunting large game, earning the nickname 'Gray Ghost' for its coat and stealth.

name: Welsh Springer Spaniel
summary: Medium-sized, compact gundog with a distinctive red and white coat and straight, silky feathering. Known for its happy disposition, boundless energy, and versatility in the field as a sporting spaniel built for endurance.

name: Wetterhoun
summary: Medium-sized Dutch water dog from Friesland with a distinctive thick, curly, water-resistant coat. Originally bred for hunting otters and waterfowl, this robust breed combines independence with loyalty and serves as both a versatile hunting dog and natural watchdog.

name: Wirehaired Pointing Griffon
summary: Medium-sized versatile gundog with distinctive harsh, wiry coat and characteristic beard and eyebrows. Known as the 'supreme gundog' with excellent pointing and retrieving abilities and an intelligent, friendly disposition.

name: Wirehaired Vizsla
summary: Medium-sized Hungarian sporting dog with a distinctive dense, wiry coat and golden rust coloring. Features a robust yet lean build and versatile hunting ability, bred for pointing and retrieving in harsh terrain.

name: Beagle
summary: A small scent hound with a tri-color coat and a nose that leads the way (and a famously loud voice).

name: Dachshund
summary: A long-bodied, short-legged hound bred to follow badgers underground. Smooth, wirehaired, and longhaired varieties exist.
traits: Very long body on very short legs
Smooth, wire, or long coat varieties
Deep chest and a bold, confident stance

name: Rhodesian Ridgeback
summary: A muscular, wheaten-colored hound named for the ridge of backward-growing hair along its spine.
traits: A ridge of hair along the back growing against the coat
Muscular, athletic build with a deep chest
Dark muzzle and ears on many dogs

name: Afghan Hound
summary: Ancient, elegant sighthound with dramatic, flowing silky coat and aristocratic bearing, bred for hunting large prey in mountainous terrain

name: Africanis
summary: Medium-sized, athletic landrace dog indigenous to Southern Africa with variable appearance and short coat, naturally evolved through centuries of selection by African communities and adapted to harsh environments

name: Alopekis
summary: Small, fox-like Greek primitive landrace breed with wedge-shaped head and agile build, historically used as an all-purpose farm dog for companionship, watching, and vermin control

name: Alpine Dachsbracke
summary: Sturdy, short-legged Austrian scent hound with dense double coat, originally bred for tracking wounded game in high-altitude Alpine terrain. Built low-to-the-ground with a robust, weather-resistant build designed for rugged mountainous conditions.

name: American English Coonhound
summary: Athletic medium to large scent hound with excellent tracking ability, swift and powerful build, and a hard, protective short coat. Bred for treeing raccoons and fox, known for speed, endurance, and distinctive melodious baying.

name: American Foxhound
summary: A sleek, powerful scenthound with a long, fine-boned body and athletic build, known for incredible stamina, speed, and melodious baying voice. One of the oldest American-bred dogs, developed for endurance and pack hunting.

name: American Leopard Hound
summary: Medium to large athletic scent hound known for its distinctive leopard-spotted or patched coat pattern and exceptional tracking ability. A tough, powerful, and driven American tree and trailing hound with strong hunting instincts and versatile hunting capabilities.

name: Anglo-Français de Petite Vénerie
summary: Medium-sized, elegant and well-balanced French scenthound with a short tricolor coat, bred for hunting small game in packs with excellent scenting ability and strong pack hunting instincts

name: Ariégeois
summary: Medium-sized, elegant French scenthound with distinctive tricolor coat, lean body, long ears, and light limbs. Bred for pack-hunting hare and deer, known for keen nose, stamina, and scent-tracking abilities.

name: Artois Hound
summary: Medium-sized French scent hound with distinctive short, dense tricolor coat and powerful build. Known for its endurance, strong hunting instincts, and calm yet energetic temperament.

name: Austrian Black and Tan Hound
summary: Medium-sized, athletic scent hound with a smooth black coat and distinctive rich tan markings, renowned for its stamina, keen sense of smell, and elegant build. Developed specifically for tracking game in mountainous Alpine terrain.

name: Azawakh
origin: West Africa (Sahel region: Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso)
summary: Elegant, tall sighthound from West Africa with a lean, muscular build, fine coat, and long legs built for speed and endurance in desert conditions of the Sahel region

name: Banjara Hound
summary: Ancient, lean athletic sighthound landrace native to India, traditionally used by nomadic Banjara people for hunting game over harsh terrain. Known for endurance, loyalty, and speed, bred for function over form.

name: Barak Hound
summary: Medium-sized rough-coated scent hound with distinctive tricolor coat, bred for hunting in mountainous terrain across the Balkans

name: Basenji
summary: Small, elegant sighthound from Central Africa with a tightly curled tail, wrinkled forehead, and smooth coat. Known as the 'barkless dog' for its unique yodel-like vocalizations instead of traditional barking.

name: Basset Artésien Normand
summary: A French short-legged scenthound with a long back, noble head, very long ears, and tricolour or bicolour coat, known for its tenacity on the trail and affectionate nature at home

name: Basset Bleu de Gascogne
summary: Medium-sized, low-slung French scent hound with distinctive blue-mottled coat, long drooping ears, and exceptional tracking abilities. Known for its noble expression and remarkable sense of smell.

name: Basset Fauve de Bretagne
summary: Small, compact scent hound with harsh, wiry fawn to golden-red coat and sturdy build. Known for its energetic, happy disposition and lively temperament, originally bred for hunting small game in Brittany.

name: Basset Hound
summary: Low-slung, heavy-boned scent hound with distinctive long, velvety ears, mournful expression, and loose skin. Known for powerful tracking ability and calm demeanor.

name: Bavarian Mountain Hound
summary: Medium-sized, lean and muscular scent hound with exceptional tracking abilities and endurance, developed for following wounded game in mountainous terrain. Known for its calm and poised demeanor combined with courage and devotion.

name: Beagle-Harrier
summary: Medium-sized, sturdily built French scent hound created by crossing Beagles and Harriers, known for its balanced build, short dense coat, and energetic disposition with a passion for hunting

name: Billy
summary: Large, elegant French scent hound with a predominantly white coat and orange or lemon markings, known for speed, stamina and light-framed build bred for pack hunting

name: Black and Tan Coonhound
summary: Large, powerful American-bred scent hound with distinctive black and tan coat pattern and long ears, known for its cold nose, loud bawling bark, and determined trailing ability

name: Black Mouth Cur
summary: Medium to large rugged, well-muscled working and hunting dog from the American South, known for its versatility, courage, intelligence, and characteristic black-pigmented muzzle and lips

name: Black Norwegian Elkhound
summary: Medium-sized spitz-type hunting dog with solid black double coat and robust, compact build. A bold, energetic breed smaller than its grey counterpart, built for endurance and agility as an all-purpose hunter with alert expression and confident demeanor.

name: Bloodhound
summary: Large, substantial scent hound with a noble, dignified expression, characterized by exceptional tracking ability, distinctive wrinkled face, long drooping ears, loose skin, and pendulous jowls. Renowned for its extraordinary sense of smell and unparalleled tracking abilities.

name: Bluetick Coonhound
summary: Large, athletic, and muscular scenthound with distinctive blue-ticked coat pattern and renowned 'cold nose' trailing ability, bred specifically for tracking and treeing raccoons

name: Borzoi
summary: Large, elegant sighthound with long, silky flowing coat and aristocratic bearing, known for grace, speed, and gentle nature. Originally bred by Russian nobility for coursing wolves and game.

name: Briquet de Provence
summary: Medium-sized, elegant French scent hound with short coat and distinctive tri-color markings, well-proportioned with lean muscle built for endurance and hunting small game in Mediterranean terrain

name: Briquet Griffon Vendéen
summary: Medium-sized rough-coated French scenthound known for its courage, determination, and stamina in the hunt, with a sturdy build designed for hunting in dense terrain and a friendly, energetic disposition

name: Bruno Jura Hound
summary: Medium-sized, noble Swiss scent hound with tan to black coat and distinctive black saddle, known for its keen nose, endurance, and strong tracking instincts. Features long, dropped ears and a gentle, sometimes melancholic expression, bred for hunting in mountainous terrain.

name: Bulgarian Hound
summary: Medium-sized scent hound of balanced and elegant conformation with strong hunting instincts and sturdy build. Features a tricolor or black-and-tan short, dense coat with well-developed undercoat, developed for tracking both small and large game in Bulgarian terrain.

name: Bulgarian Scenthound
summary: Medium-sized, well-proportioned scent hound with a strong, elegant build and short, dense coat. Developed for hunting in Bulgarian mountainous terrain, this robust breed has exceptional scenting ability and is traditionally used for trailing both small and large game including wild boar, deer, and hare.

name: Carolina Dog
summary: Medium-sized, athletic primitive breed with sand-colored coat and erect ears, resembling a dingo or small wolf with ancient pariah dog characteristics

name: Chart Polski
summary: Large, powerful, and muscular sighthound with an elegant build, short coat, and dignified appearance, known for its speed, courage, stamina, and reserved nature. Bred for hunting in Polish terrain with great determination and character.

name: Chien Français Blanc et Noir
summary: Large, powerful, and elegant French scent hound distinguished by its distinctive black and white coat, bred for hunting large game in packs with endurance and persistence

name: Chien Français Blanc et Orange
summary: Large, noble, and muscular French scent hound with distinctive white and orange coat, bred for pack hunting large game such as deer and boar. Known for stamina, endurance, and ability to work collaboratively in packs.

name: Chien Français Tricolore
summary: Large, elegant, and powerful French scenthound with distinctive tricolor coat, built for speed and endurance while pack hunting large game, particularly deer

name: Chippiparai
summary: Ancient Indian sighthound breed from Tamil Nadu, known for its lean, elegant build and exceptional speed. This athletic breed has a very short, close coat typically in shades of fawn, reddish-brown, or brindle, and is prized for its hunting prowess and reserved loyalty to family.

name: Chortai
summary: Rare, elegant sighthound from Central Asia with athletic build and short coat, bred for exceptional speed and endurance when coursing game across harsh steppe terrain

name: Cirneco dell'Etna
summary: Ancient medium-sized sighthound with short coat, elegant slender build, and distinctive large ears. Bred for hunting on the rugged volcanic terrain of Mount Etna, this athletic breed combines endurance with graceful movement.

name: Colombian Fino Hound
summary: A medium-sized Colombian scenthound of noble appearance with athletic build, characterized by long ears, a sad expression, short smooth coat, and exceptional scenting abilities. Known in its native country as the Sabueso Fino Colombiano.

name: Cretan Hound
summary: Ancient, primitive Mediterranean sighthound from Greece with slender, athletic build, erect ears, and curled tail. Known for exceptional speed, agility, and keen hunting instincts over harsh, rocky terrain.

name: Denmark Feist
summary: Small to medium agile hunting dog of the Treeing Feist type, specifically developed for treeing small game, especially squirrels. Known for its tenacity, high energy, and alert nature with strong hunting instincts.

name: Dikkulak
summary: A rare Turkish landrace dog characterized by distinctive erect ears from which it gets its name ('prick ear'). Small to medium-sized with spitz-type features and sighthound heritage, bred for guarding homesteads and hunting in rural Anatolia.

name: Dingo
summary: An ancient, primitive wild canid native to Australia with a lean, medium-sized build, wolf-like appearance, pricked ears, and bushy tail. Recognized for its reddish-tan coat and high intelligence, it is considered a wild dog rather than a domesticated breed.

name: Drever
summary: Short-legged, long-bodied Swedish scent hound with distinctive white markings, known for endurance, keen nose, and even-tempered nature. Built for tracking deer and game over difficult terrain with robust, agile construction.

name: Dunker
summary: Medium-sized Norwegian scenthound with athletic build and distinctive harlequin, blue-merle, or marbled coat pattern, known for endurance and bred specifically for hare hunting

name: English Foxhound
summary: Large, athletic scent hound with classic pack-hound build, bred for fox hunting with exceptional endurance and stamina. Features a short, hard, dense coat and powerful, musical voice with distinctive bay.

name: Erbi Txakur
summary: Medium-sized, agile scent hound from the Basque Country, specifically bred for hunting hare and small game, known for its endurance, keen sense of smell, and ability to work over challenging terrain

name: Estonian Hound
summary: Medium-sized, strong-boned scent hound with short, smooth tricolor coat and sturdy build, known for its tenacity in hunting small game and stamina in Estonia's terrain

name: Finnish Hound
summary: Medium-sized tricolor scent hound developed for endurance hunting of hare and fox in challenging Nordic terrain, known for its energetic nature and melodious voice

name: Gascon Saintongeois
summary: Large, noble and powerfully built French scenthound with distinctive tricolor coat and elegant appearance. Known for its superb nose, melodious voice, and pack-hunting endurance, this athletic breed was developed for hunting large game in southwestern France.

name: German Hound
summary: Medium-sized scent hound with athletic build and tricolor short coat, bred for hunting in packs with elegant, resilient structure and muscular build

name: Gończy Polski
summary: Medium-sized Polish scent hound with muscular, compact build and strong hunting instincts, known for its courage, intelligence, and distinctive sonorous voice

name: Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Noir
aliases: Great Anglo-French White and Black Hound
summary: Large, powerful, and elegant French scent hound with distinctive black and white coat markings, bred for pack hunting large game with exceptional stamina and fine nose

name: Grand Anglo-Français Blanc et Orange
aliases: Great Anglo-French White and Orange Hound
summary: Large, powerful, and elegant French scenthound with distinctive white and orange coat, bred for pack hunting of large game. This athletic hunting hound combines French and Anglo heritage with strong hunting abilities and determined tracking instincts.

name: Grand Anglo-Français Tricolore
summary: Large, powerful, and elegant French scent hound with a distinctive tricolor coat, specifically bred for pack hunting large game like deer. This athletic breed combines French hound heritage with English Foxhound influences.

name: Grand Basset Griffon Vendéen
summary: Medium-sized, long-backed, short-legged French scent hound with a rough, shaggy coat, noble head, and cheerful, independent personality bred for hunting hare and rabbit over rough terrain

name: Grand Bleu de Gascogne
summary: Large, noble French scenthound with distinctive blue-mottled coat and pendulous ears, known for its powerful nose, deep sonorous voice, and noble bearing. Bred for hunting large game in packs.

name: Grand Griffon Vendéen
summary: Large, sturdily built French scent hound with a rough double coat, distinctive beard and mustache, and noble appearance. Known for exceptional stamina, courage, and independent nature, bred for hunting wild boar and deer in rough terrain.

name: Greek Harehound
summary: Medium-sized, athletic scenthound with a short, dense black and tan coat, bred for stamina and endurance when hunting hare in rugged Greek terrain. Known for its keen sense of smell and tenacious tracking ability.

name: Greyhound
summary: An ancient sighthound with tall, lean, elegant build designed for exceptional speed. Known for their gentle temperament and often described as a '45-mph couch potato', combining incredible athleticism with calm, affectionate nature.

name: Griffon Bleu de Gascogne
summary: Medium-sized, rustic-looking French scenthound with distinctive blue-mottled, rough coat and strong hunting instincts. Known for exceptional stamina and a melodious voice, this persistent and versatile hunter combines keen scenting ability with rugged durability.

name: Griffon Fauve de Bretagne
summary: Medium-sized rough-coated French scent hound with harsh, wiry fawn to red coat and keen hunting instincts, known for tenacity in the hunt and rustic appearance

name: Griffon Nivernais
summary: Medium-sized French scent hound with a robust build, rough shaggy coat, and rugged appearance. Known for exceptional hunting ability in difficult terrain and strong work-focused instincts.

name: Halden Hound
summary: Medium-sized, rectangular Norwegian scenthound with distinctive short, dense coat, built for speed and endurance as a hare hunter in challenging terrain. Features a proud yet gentle expression with the stamina and resilience needed for Norwegian hunting conditions.

name: Hällefors Elkhound
summary: Medium-sized spitz-type hunting dog developed in Sweden for elk and large game hunting, featuring a dense double coat and rectangular build designed for persistence and courage in dense forests

name: Hamiltonstövare
summary: Medium-sized Swedish tricolor scent hound with athletic build and noble appearance, bred for endurance and skill in hunting fox and hare over challenging terrain

name: Hanoverian Scenthound
summary: Robust medium-large scenthound known for its exceptional tracking ability and calm, determined temperament. Descended from medieval Liam hounds, this breed was specifically developed to track wounded game for hunters.

name: Harrier
summary: Medium-sized athletic scent hound bred for pack hunting hare, resembling a smaller English Foxhound with sturdy build, short dense coat, and excellent stamina

name: Hygen Hound
summary: Medium-sized, strong and compact Norwegian scenthound with lean athletic build, developed for endurance in rough terrain and known for excellent tracking abilities and affectionate nature with family

name: Ibizan Hound
summary: Elegant sighthound with distinctive large erect ears, lean athletic build, and deer-like grace. Known for remarkable jumping ability and bred for hunting rabbit by sight, this ancient breed comes in both smooth and wire-coated varieties.

name: Indian Pariah Dog
summary: Medium-sized primitive landrace breed native to the Indian subcontinent with erect ears, short coat, and naturally hardy constitution developed through thousands of years of natural selection

name: Irish Wolfhound
summary: A giant-sized sighthound of imposing appearance and dignified nature, the Irish Wolfhound is the tallest of all dog breeds. Known for its wiry, rough coat and gentle giant temperament, this ancient breed combines courage with a calm, dignified demeanor.

name: Istrian Coarse-haired Hound
summary: Medium-sized, noble-looking scent hound with distinctive harsh, wiry white coat and orange markings, bred for hunting in the mountainous terrain of Istria. Known for its calm, gentle demeanor and tenacious hunting ability with a deep, resonant voice.

name: Istrian Shorthaired Hound
summary: Medium-sized, noble-looking scent hound of ancient lineage with a smooth white coat and distinctive orange markings, bred for hunting hare and fox with a strong, sonorous voice

name: Jämthund
summary: Large, athletic spitz-type hunting dog from Sweden with wolf-like appearance and strong build, known for its endurance and courageous nature in hunting large game under harsh Nordic conditions

name: Jonangi
summary: Medium-sized agile Indian spitz-type dog with short smooth coat, webbed feet, and pricked ears. Known for its unique yodel-like vocalization and traditionally used for duck herding, hunting, and fishing activities.

name: Kaikadi
summary: Small to medium-sized sighthound from Maharashtra, India, with a slender, athletic build and short, fine coat. Named after the Kaikadi nomadic tribe, this ancient landrace breed is known for its agility and exceptional hunting abilities.

name: Kanni
summary: Rare, elegant sighthound landrace from Tamil Nadu, India, with a lean, athletic build and short, fine coat typically in black-and-tan or cream. Known for incredible speed, loyalty, and independent nature, traditionally prized for hunting.

name: Kazakh Tazy
summary: Ancient Central Asian sighthound with elegant, long-legged build and characteristic feathering on ears, tail, and legs. Known for exceptional speed, stamina, and endurance, developed for hunting in harsh steppe conditions.

name: Kerry Beagle
summary: Medium-large Irish scent hound with a smooth, dense coat and distinctive black and tan markings, one of Ireland's oldest native breeds known for stamina and strong hunting instincts

name: Khala
summary: A rare, primitive hairless landrace breed from Bolivia existing in two size varieties (Medio and Grande), with a distinctive sighthound-like build, hairless body, and tufts of hair on feet and tail. Also has a coated variety.

name: Kombai
summary: Medium-sized, powerful and athletic Indian hunting dog from Southern India with a distinctive tan coat and muscular build, known for its courage in hunting large game like wild boar, bison, and deer

name: Lài
summary: Medium-sized, primitive spitz-type dog native to northern Vietnam; agile, hardy, and versatile

name: Langqing
summary: A rare, athletic sighthound landrace from China, known for its lean build, fine coat, and exceptional hunting ability. Also known as the Guizhou Hound.

name: Levriero Sardo
summary: Rare, ancient sighthound landrace from Sardinia, Italy, known for its lean, athletic build and speed. This slender breed has strong hunting instincts and a reserved, independent temperament, traditionally used for hunting hares and small game across rugged terrain.

name: Liangshan Dog
origin: Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, China
summary: A primitive, large native Chinese breed from the mountainous Liangshan region of Sichuan, known for its lean athleticism, protective instincts, and versatility as both a hunting and livestock guardian dog with exceptional courage and endurance

name: Lithuanian Hound
summary: Medium-sized, strong and tenacious scenthound with a short, glossy black and tan coat, developed for hunting in Lithuanian forests and known for endurance and strong hunting instincts

name: Magyar Agár
summary: Ancient Hungarian sighthound with elegant, robust build and short coat, bred for speed, stamina, and open-field coursing game across the Hungarian plains

name: Mahratta Hound
summary: A rare, medium-sized sighthound from the Maharashtra region of India, known for its lean build, speed, stamina, and keen eyesight. Closely related to the Caravan Hound, this ancient breed is prized for its hunting prowess.

name: Miniature Dachshund
summary: A small, elongated scent hound breed originating from Germany. Originally bred to flush out rabbits and small quarry from burrows, the Miniature Dachshund is clever, playful, and courageous, known for its distinct long-backed and short-legged silhouette.

name: Montenegrin Mountain Hound
summary: Medium-sized, agile scenthound from the Balkans with a distinctive black and tan coat and robust build. Known for its docility, dedication to hunting, and keen tracking ability in mountainous terrain.

name: Mountain Cur
origin: Southern United States (Appalachian and Ozark Mountains)
summary: Medium-sized rugged treeing hound and farm dog with strong, muscular build, bred as a pioneer's all-purpose hunting companion known for courage, athleticism, and excellent treeing abilities in mountainous terrain

name: Mountain Feist
origin: Southern United States (Appalachian and Ozark Mountains)
summary: Small to medium-sized hunting dog with compact, muscular build and short coat, developed in the southern United States for treeing small game. Known for exceptional agility, alertness, and tenacious hunting ability.

name: Mudhol Hound
summary: Ancient, elegant Indian sighthound with lean, athletic build and narrow head, known for remarkable speed, stamina, and loyalty. Also known as the Caravan Hound.

name: New Guinea Singing Dog
summary: Primitive medium-small wild dog known for distinctive howling vocalizations, fox-like appearance, and exceptional agility. Closely related to the dingo, this rare breed retains wild characteristics and is considered semi-domesticated.

name: Norrbottenspets
summary: Small, compact spitz-type hunting dog from northern Sweden with erect ears, curled tail, and white coat with colored patches. Known for its alert, agile, and fearless nature with a well-muscled body built for athleticism.

name: Norwegian Elkhound
summary: Medium-sized spitz-type hunting dog with thick double coat and curled tail, bred for hunting elk and moose. Bold and energetic, this hardy gray hunting dog is known for its versatility, courage, and stamina in tracking large game.

name: Otterhound
summary: Large, shaggy-coated scent hound with webbed feet and waterproof double coat, bred for hunting otters in medieval England. Known for its boisterous and amiable temperament, keen nose, and distinctive love of water.

name: Pampas Deerhound
summary: Large athletic sighthound developed for hunting deer in the South American grasslands. Also known as Veadeiro Pampeano, this slender but strong scenthound is known for its keen hunting ability, endurance, and resistance.

name: Petit Basset Griffon Vendéen
summary: Small, rough-coated French scent hound with sturdy build, distinctive beard and mustache, built low to the ground for hunting rabbit and hare through dense underbrush. Known for their happy demeanor and lively personality.

name: Petit Bleu de Gascogne
summary: Medium-sized, noble French scent hound distinguished by its distinctive mottled 'blue' coat, long drooping ears, and exceptional sense of smell. Originally developed as a smaller version of the Grand Bleu de Gascogne, this diligent and determined hunter excels at tracking small game.

name: Pharaoh Hound
summary: Medium-sized elegant sighthound with short tan coat, alert expression, and distinctive ability to 'blush' on nose and ears when excited. A graceful, powerful, and swift breed of ancient origins.

name: Phu Quoc Ridgeback
summary: Medium-sized, athletic primitive hunting dog from Vietnam, distinguished by a characteristic ridge of hair running along its back in the opposite direction from the rest of the coat. One of only three ridge-backed breeds in the world, this agile and intelligent dog originated on Phu Quoc Island.

name: Plott Hound
summary: Athletic, streamlined, and powerful scent hound with distinctive brindle coat, known for its intelligence, courage, and exceptional tracking ability. Originally bred for big-game hunting including bear and boar.

name: Podenco Andaluz
summary: An ancient, agile Spanish sighthound from the Andalusia region with erect ears and athletic build, known for its keen senses and hunting prowess. Exists in three size varieties and three coat types, specialized for rabbit hunting in Andalusian terrain.

name: Podenco Canario
summary: An ancient, athletic sighthound of primitive type from the Canary Islands, characterized by its lean, elegant build, large erect ears, and remarkable agility. This medium-sized hunting dog has a smooth short coat and slender build optimized for speed and hunting rabbits in rocky volcanic terrain.

name: Podenco Valenciano
summary: Medium-sized, primitive-type sighthound from the Valencian region of Spain with lean, athletic build and large ears. Known for its keen hunting senses using sight, smell, and hearing, this agile breed was traditionally used for rabbit hunting across varied terrain.

name: Poitevin
summary: Large, elegant French scent hound with distinctive tricolor coat and lean, muscular build. Bred for endurance and stamina in pack hunting, originally developed for hunting wolves and large game with exceptional scenting ability and melodic voice.

name: Polish Hound
summary: Medium-sized, strongly built scent hound with robust build and distinctive black and tan coat, bred for stamina and tracking large game in dense forests. Known for its powerful, melodious voice and calm yet alert temperament.

name: Porcelaine
summary: Elegant, medium-sized French scenthound with a distinctive glossy white coat that gives the breed its name, resembling porcelain. Known for its refined build, endurance, speed, and exceptional nose for hunting.

name: Portuguese Podengo
summary: Ancient multi-purpose hound from Portugal that comes in three sizes (Pequeno, Medio, Grande) and two coat types (smooth and wire). Medium-sized, agile breed with erect ears, wedge-shaped head, and keen sight and scent abilities developed for hunting rabbits and small game

name: Posavac Hound
summary: Medium-sized Croatian scenthound of robust, noble build with distinctive reddish coat and white markings. Known for exceptional stamina, scenting ability, and sonorous voice when tracking.

name: Rajapalayam
summary: Large, muscular Indian sighthound with pristine white coat and distinctive pink nose. This powerful breed has a loyal, protective nature and was historically used for hunting wild boar and as a royal companion.

name: Rampur Greyhound
summary: Large, powerfully-built sighthound from India with a lean, athletic build and short coat, known for incredible speed, endurance, and deep loyalty, originally developed for hunting large game in the Indian subcontinent

name: Rastreador Brasileiro
summary: Large, athletic Brazilian scenthound with a short, dense coat, developed for tracking jaguar and other large game with exceptional scenting ability, known for perseverance and courage in hunting

name: Redbone Coonhound
summary: Medium to large athletic hound with a striking solid red coat, known for its speed, agility, and powerful scenting ability. Sleek and muscular, this breed was developed specifically for hunting raccoons and other game.

name: Ryukyu
summary: Medium-sized, primitive hunting dog from the Ryukyu Islands of Japan with an athletic build, triangular ears, and a distinctive brindle coat. Known for its loyalty to family and traditional use in wild boar hunting. Also, known as 'Ryukyu Inu'.

name: Sabueso Español
summary: A medium-sized, ancient Spanish scenthound characterized by its long, pendulous ears, noble expression, and exceptional scenting ability, bred for tracking game across varied terrain of the Iberian Peninsula

name: Saluki
summary: Ancient, elegant sighthound of the Middle East with graceful build, feathered ears and tail, known for extraordinary speed, endurance, and dignified nature. Bred for hunting gazelle across desert terrain.

name: Sarail Hound
summary: A rare, tall, and athletic sighthound native to Bangladesh, renowned for its speed, endurance, and hunting ability. Known for being courageous, loyal, and protective, this breed was historically prized for hunting and guarding estates.

name: Schillerstövare
summary: A medium-sized, noble Swedish scenthound with a distinctive tan coat and black mantle, known for its athletic nature and exceptional ability as a hunter of fox and hare. This energetic Scandinavian breed combines endurance with keen scenting abilities.

name: Schweizer Laufhund
summary: Medium-sized Swiss scent hound with lean, athletic build and distinctive tricolor or bicolor coat, bred for tracking game in mountainous terrain. Known for noble appearance, endurance, and passionate hunting ability, this ancient breed comes in four distinct varieties: Bernese, Jura, Lucerne, and Schwyz.

name: Schweizerischer Niederlaufhund
summary: A smaller version of the Swiss Hound, the Schweizerischer Niederlaufhund (Small Swiss Hound) is a sturdy, energetic scenthound with short legs bred for hunting in the mountainous terrain of Switzerland. This medium-small scent hound comes in four distinct coat varieties and possesses keen hunting instincts ideal for tracking game in confined territories.

name: Scottish Deerhound
summary: Large, athletic sighthound with rough, wiry coat and dignified bearing, often called the 'Royal Dog of Scotland', bred for coursing giant red deer in the Scottish Highlands

name: Segugio dell'Appennino
summary: A medium-sized, rugged Italian scenthound with a short coat (smooth or wire-haired varieties), specifically developed for hunting hare in the challenging mountainous terrain of the Apennines. This athletic, work-focused breed combines intelligence with the independent determination typical of scenthounds.

name: Segugio Italiano
summary: An ancient Italian scenthound of noble appearance with medium-sized, athletic build and distinctive hound features. Bred for speed and endurance in hunting, the breed comes in two coat varieties: shorthaired (pelo raso) and wirehaired (pelo forte), renowned for exceptional scenting ability.

name: Segugio Maremmano
summary: Medium-sized Italian scent hound with athletic build and strong hunting instincts, developed for wild boar hunting in the Maremma region of Tuscany. Known for its endurance, determination, and sturdy rustic build designed for challenging terrain.

name: Serbian Hound
summary: Medium-sized, robust scent hound with a distinctive short, dense red coat and black saddle (mantle), known for stamina, determination, and endurance in mountainous hunting terrain

name: Serbian Tricolour Hound
summary: Medium-sized, robust scenthound with distinctive tricolor coat and solid construction, known for its tenacity, keen tracking ability, and lively temperament. Bred for hunting hare, fox, and larger game like wild boar in mountainous terrain.

name: Silken Windhound
summary: Medium-sized graceful sighthound with a silky, moderately long coat and elegant athletic build, combining the speed of a sighthound with a trainable, affectionate temperament and gentle nature

name: Sinhala Hound
summary: An ancient landrace sighthound from Sri Lanka with a lean, athletic build and short coat. This medium-sized primitive dog is known for its keen hunting instincts, alert expression, and reserved yet loyal nature.

name: Sloughi
summary: Ancient, elegant North African sighthound with lean athletic build and smooth short coat, bred by Berber and Bedouin tribes for hunting in desert terrain. Known for its noble, graceful appearance and reserved temperament.

name: Slovenský kopov
summary: Medium-sized black and tan scent hound of Slovakian origin, known for exceptional endurance and tenacious courage. Bred specifically for tracking and hunting wild boar in mountainous and rugged terrain, this persistent scenthound combines intelligence with a distinctive work-focused temperament.

name: Smaland Hound
summary: Medium-sized Swedish scenthound and the oldest native Swedish scent hound, featuring a compact, sturdy build with a tricolor coat and often naturally bobbed tail. Known for keen hunting ability and alert, energetic temperament.

name: Small Međimurje Dog
summary: A small Croatian hunting dog with compact build and keen scenting abilities, historically known as 'Međimurski ftičar' (little bird hunter). This rare, energetic breed combines primitive-type characteristics with scenthound abilities and makes a loyal companion and courageous watchdog.

name: Spanish Greyhound
summary: An ancient sighthound breed from Spain known for its lean, athletic build, speed, and gentle, calm temperament. Also called Galgo Español, they come in both smooth and wire-coated varieties and are bred for grace and reserved demeanor.

name: Spino degli Iblei
summary: Medium-sized rough-coated Italian hunting dog developed in the Iblean Mountains of Sicily for wild boar and game tracking, characterized by a rustic appearance and strong territorial nature

name: St. Hubert Jura Hound
summary: A medium-sized Swiss scent hound of the Jura variety, distinguished by its noble appearance, long ears, and more substantial head structure indicating St. Hubert Hound influence. Known for exceptional stamina, tracking ability, and endurance in mountainous terrain.

name: Stephens Stock
summary: Medium-sized American treeing hound with compact, muscular build and agile frame. Known for courage, intelligence, and tenacity in hunting game from squirrels to bears. Features a short, dense coat typically black with white markings or black and tan coloring.

name: Styrian Coarse-haired Hound
summary: Medium-sized, rugged Austrian scent hound with a distinctive coarse, wiry red coat, known for its perseverance and stamina as a hunter in mountainous terrain. Bred specifically for tracking wounded game over difficult, high-altitude terrain.

name: Taigan
summary: Ancient, elegant sighthound from the high-altitude Tian Shan mountains of Kyrgyzstan with long, silky coat and feathered ears, adapted for hunting in mountainous terrain

name: Telomian
summary: Medium-sized primitive spitz-type dog from Malaysia with distinctive upright ears, curled tail, and compact athletic build. Known for its unique climbing ability and originally developed by the Orang Asli people for hunting and pest control.

name: Thai Ridgeback
summary: An ancient, medium-sized hound known for the distinctive ridge of hair running along its back, with a muscular, athletic build and an independent, protective nature

name: Transylvanian Hound
summary: An ancient Hungarian scent hound of medium-to-large size, known for its athletic build, endurance, and distinctive short black-and-tan coat. This courageous and determined hunter was specifically adapted for mountainous terrain and varied landscapes.

name: Treeing Cur
summary: Medium-sized, athletic, and versatile hunting dog developed in the rural United States, bred specifically for treeing game and working in rural environments. Known for its intelligence, courage, and strong working ability.

name: Treeing Feist
summary: Small to medium-sized, athletic hunting dog developed in the Southern United States, known for its tenacity in treeing small game like squirrels and raccoons with high energy and strong prey drive

name: Treeing Tennessee Brindle
summary: Medium-sized, athletic scent hound known for its distinctive brindle coat pattern, intelligence, and persistent treeing ability. Fast and agile with a loud, distinctive bark, this breed excels at tracking and treeing small game.

name: Treeing Walker Coonhound
summary: Medium to large athletic scent hound with distinctive tricolor coat, bred for tracking and treeing raccoons and other game in rugged terrain. Known for swift endurance, intelligence, and distinctive baying voice.

name: Trigg Hound
summary: Athletic, medium-sized American foxhound strain developed for exceptional speed, stamina, and endurance in fox hunting. Known for its lean build, distinctive running style, and loud, carrying voice with keen scenting ability.

name: Tyrolean Hound
summary: Medium-sized, athletic scent hound with a strong, sinewy build and dense double coat, developed for endurance and tracking ability in mountainous terrain

name: Villanuco de Las Encartaciones
summary: Small, primitive-type Spanish ratter dog from the Basque Country, known for its agile, alert, and rustic nature, traditionally used for vermin control

name: Welsh Hound
summary: Medium to large-sized, powerful and athletic scent hound with strong pack hunting instincts, built for stamina and endurance over rough Welsh terrain. Known for its distinct, ringing voice and rugged, weatherproof coat.

name: West Country Harrier
summary: Medium to substantial scent hound with a broad head, dense short weather-resistant coat, and powerful frame developed for pack hunting hare across the varied rough terrain of Southwest England. This rare or extinct regional variant of the Harrier retains stronger Foxhound influence.

name: Westphalian Dachsbracke
summary: Short-legged, sturdy German scent hound with tricolor coat, developed for hunting in dense terrain and tracking wounded game

name: Whippet
summary: Medium-sized, sleek sighthound known for its elegant athletic build with distinctive 'inverted S' shape, explosive bursts of speed, and gentle nature. Originally known as the 'poor man's racehorse'.

name: Xiasi Dog
summary: A lean, muscular, medium-sized hunting dog from the Guizhou province of China, known for its short wiry coat, loyalty, and athletic ability. This agile breed was prized as a versatile hunting and guard dog, believed to bring wealth and good fortune to families.

name: Xigou
summary: Ancient Chinese sighthound breed, sometimes called the 'Chinese Greyhound', with a slender build, long legs, and elegant appearance. Known for speed, endurance, and calm demeanor, it comes in both smooth and long-haired varieties with several regional variations.

name: Siberian Husky
summary: A medium-sized sled dog with a thick double coat, upright ears, and often striking blue or mismatched eyes.
traits: Face mask markings and often blue or bi-colored eyes
Brush-like tail often carried in a sickle curve

name: Bernese Mountain Dog
summary: A large, tri-color farm dog with a long silky coat and a gentle, sturdy presence.
traits: Tri-color: black with rust and white markings
White blaze on face and white chest cross

name: Akita
summary: A large, powerful spitz-type dog with a broad head, small ears, and a thick tail curled over the back.
traits: Thick tail curled over the back
Heavy-boned, powerful build with a dense double coat

name: Aidi
summary: Medium to large, powerful and muscular Moroccan mountain dog with thick, weather-resistant double coat bred as a livestock guardian and protector in the rugged Atlas Mountains

name: Akbash
summary: Large, powerful, all-white livestock guardian dog from Turkey with lean athletic build, known for its independent nature and strong protective instincts. The distinctive white coat helped shepherds distinguish it from predators at a distance.

name: Aksaray Malaklisi
summary: A giant and powerful livestock guardian dog from the Aksaray region of Turkey, characterized by its massive frame, muscular build, and pendulous lips from which it gets its name ('Malakli' meaning 'with lips'). Known for exceptional size and protective instincts.

name: Alano Español
summary: A large, athletic Molosser-type dog with a powerful, agile build and brachycephalic head. This robust Spanish breed has a short coat, serious expression, and strong working instincts, historically used as a catch dog for large game and cattle work.

name: Alapaha Blue Blood Bulldog
origin: Alapaha River region of southern Georgia, United States
summary: A powerful, athletic bulldog breed with distinctive blue merle or patched coat patterns and muscular build. Originally developed as a 'catch dog' for farm work, livestock protection, and family guardian with strong protective instincts.

name: Alaskan Malamute
summary: An immensely strong, heavy-duty freighting dog of spitz type, the Alaskan Malamute is a large, powerful Arctic sled dog with a thick double coat, deep chest, well-muscled body, wolf-like appearance, and characteristically plumed tail carried over the back

name: American Bulldog
summary: A powerful, athletic, short-coated dog of the molosser type with a broad head and muscular build, known for its confidence, strength, and loyalty as a family companion and guardian. Originally bred for farm work and protection.

name: Appenzeller Sennenhund
summary: Medium-sized, muscular and agile Swiss mountain dog with distinctive tricolor coat and tightly curled tail carried over the back. Known for their lively, self-assured expression and work-focused temperament, this ancient breed combines herding instincts with guarding abilities.

name: Armenian Gampr
summary: Large, powerful ancient livestock guardian dog from the Armenian Highlands, known for its thick double coat, formidable protective instincts, and independent temperament developed through millennia of natural selection

name: Austrian Pinscher
summary: Medium-sized, sturdy farm dog with robust build, distinctive pear-shaped head, and dense double coat, originally developed as a versatile guardian and ratter with strong protective instincts

name: Bakharwal Dog
summary: Large, powerful mountain dog bred for guarding livestock in the Himalayas, featuring a dense double coat and strong protective instincts

name: Bankhar Dog
summary: Large, powerful ancient livestock guardian dog from Mongolia with thick double coat and independent, protective temperament. This landrace breed is adapted to survive and work in harsh climates.

name: Black Russian Terrier
summary: Large, powerful, and robust working dog with a distinctive dense black double coat and confident demeanor. Bred for military and guard work, this hardy breed combines courage with intelligence.

name: Boerboel
summary: Large, powerful mastiff-type guardian breed from South Africa with a muscular build, short dense coat, and confident temperament. Known as a family guardian, the name 'Boerboel' translates to 'farmer's dog' in Afrikaans.

name: Boxer
summary: Medium to large, powerful and athletic working dog with a distinctive short-muzzled, flat face and short coat. Known for their fun-loving, bright temperament and expressive face, combining energy with loyalty.

name: Broholmer
summary: Large, powerful mastiff-type dog with distinctive rectangular build and calm, confident demeanor. Known for its imposing presence and steady, powerful gait, this Danish guardian breed combines strength with a gentle nature.

name: Bucovina Shepherd Dog
summary: Large, powerful livestock guardian dog from the Carpathian Mountains with a thick, dense weather-resistant double coat. Known for its calm demeanor, courage, and devotion to family and flock.

name: Bullmastiff
summary: Large, powerful guardian breed with short coat and calm, confident demeanor, originally bred to guard estates and known as 'The Gamekeeper's Night-Dog'

name: Bully Kutta
summary: Very large, powerful mastiff-type landrace breed from the Indian subcontinent with ancient origins, known for its immense strength, muscular build, and use as a guardian dog

name: Ca de Bou
summary: Medium-sized, powerful Molosser-type breed with distinctive muscular build and alert expression, also known as the Perro de Presa Mallorquin. Originally bred for bull-baiting with a calm yet courageous demeanor.

name: Ca Mè Mallorquí
summary: Medium-sized working dog from Mallorca, Spain, with a short black coat and athletic build, traditionally used for hunting and herding in Mediterranean terrain

name: Campeiro Bulldog
summary: A powerful, medium-sized Brazilian bulldog breed with muscular, athletic build, broad chest, and short coat. Historically developed for cattle work on ranches with strong work ethic and alert expression.

name: Canadian Eskimo Dog
summary: A powerful, Spitz-type working dog of the Arctic with thick double coat and imposing stature, known for exceptional endurance in sledding and hunting work. This primitive breed combines strength with hardy Arctic adaptation.

name: Cane Corso
summary: Large, powerful Italian mastiff-type dog with muscular, athletic build and confident demeanor. This intelligent and majestic breed was historically used as a guardian and hunter, known for its loyalty to family.

name: Cão de Gado Transmontano
summary: Very large, powerful molossoid-type livestock guardian dog with thick double coat, bred in the mountainous regions of northern Portugal to protect flocks from predators with a calm yet imposing and rustic demeanor

name: Carpathian Shepherd Dog
summary: Large, powerful livestock guardian dog native to the Carpathian Mountains with a wolf-like appearance and thick double coat. Known for its courageous and protective nature, this robust mountain dog was developed for guarding sheep flocks from predators including wolves and bears.

name: Castro Laboreiro Dog
summary: An ancient, large, and powerful Portuguese livestock guardian dog with a distinctive wolf-like appearance and movement. This rustic mountain breed is known for its formidable and unique graduated bark that starts low and rises in pitch.

name: Caucasian Shepherd Dog
summary: Giant, powerfully built livestock guardian breed with dense, weather-resistant double coat and imposing presence. Bred to be a formidable guardian in harsh mountain conditions with a courageous, confident demeanor.

name: Caucasian Shepherd Dog
summary: Massive, powerful livestock guardian breed with thick, weather-resistant double coat, originally bred to protect flocks from large predators like wolves and bears in the Caucasus Mountains. This formidable guardian combines strong protective instincts with courageous temperament.

name: Central Asian Shepherd Dog
summary: An ancient, large, and powerful livestock guardian breed with massive bone structure and powerful muscles. Known for its courage, confidence, territorial nature, and natural protective instincts developed over thousands of years.

name: Chinook
summary: Large, athletic American sled dog with distinctive tawny double coat, known for combining strength, endurance, and a calm, gentle temperament. This versatile working breed was developed for drafting and sled-dog racing in New England conditions.

name: Chukotka Sled Dog
summary: Arctic spitz-type sled dog from northeastern Siberia, developed by the Chukchi people for sledding, endurance, and transportation in extreme cold conditions

name: Cimarrón Uruguayo
summary: Large, powerful molossoid breed with robust bone structure and athletic build, known for its balanced temperament, courage, and protective instincts. This rugged working breed features a short brindle or fawn coat and strong working heritage.

name: Czechoslovakian Wolfdog
summary: Athletic, wolf-like working breed with a powerful build and primitive appearance, developed from German Shepherds and Carpathian wolves. Known for high energy, endurance, and independent nature with distinctive wolf-like features.

name: Doberman Pinscher
summary: Medium-large, sleek, athletic and powerful dog known for exceptional loyalty and intelligence. This elegant working breed combines strength with agility and has a confident, alert demeanor.

name: Dogo Argentino
summary: Large, powerful, all-white mastiff-type dog with massive head and athletic build, originally developed for big-game hunting with exceptional courage and strength

name: Dogo Sardesco
summary: Large, powerful Molossian-type guardian breed from Sardinia with a sturdy, muscular build and strong protective instincts. Also known as the Pastore Fonnese, this ancient landrace breed was traditionally used for livestock and property protection.

name: Dogue Brasileiro
summary: Medium to large, powerful mastiff-type breed developed in Brazil with strong guarding instincts, athletic build, and short coat. Known for its devotion to family and protective temperament.

name: Dogue de Bordeaux
summary: Massive, powerful French mastiff with distinctive short, wrinkled muzzle and red mask. This imposing molossoid dog combines a muscular build with a calm, loyal disposition and protective temperament.

name: East European Shepherd
summary: Large, powerful working dog developed in Soviet Union from German Shepherds and local breeds. Similar to German Shepherd but larger and more cold-resistant, with a slightly elongated body built for strength and endurance in harsh climates. Possesses a noble, confident demeanor.

name: English Mastiff
summary: Massive, powerful giant breed with a short fawn, apricot, or brindle coat, distinctive black mask, and dignified demeanor. Known for combining imposing size with a gentle, loyal temperament and protective instincts.

name: Estrela Mountain Dog
summary: Large, powerful, and imposing livestock guardian dog from the Estrela Mountains of Portugal with a dense double coat and protective temperament. Known for its intelligence, loyalty, and calm yet fearless demeanor, this athletic breed combines strength with a naturally protective nature.

name: Fila Brasileiro
summary: Large, powerful Molosser-type mastiff guardian breed with distinctive loose skin, natural guarding instincts, and tracking ability

name: Georgian Shepherd
summary: Large, powerful livestock guardian dog from the Caucasus mountains of Georgia, with a thick weather-resistant double coat and strong protective instincts. An ancient landrace breed known for its courage, decision-making abilities, and formidable guarding capabilities against large predators like wolves and bears.

name: German Pinscher
summary: Medium-sized, well-muscled working dog with elegant, athletic build and smooth coat. Known for its high-spirited, alert, and confident demeanor, this is one of Germany's oldest breeds.

name: Giant Schnauzer
summary: Large, powerful, and robust working dog with a dense wiry, weather-resistant coat, distinctive beard and eyebrows, and commanding, imposing presence. Originally bred for driving cattle and guarding in Germany.

name: Great Dane
summary: Giant, regal breed known as the 'Apollo of Dogs' with a powerful, well-muscled body, sleek coat, and dignified presence combined with noble bearing despite imposing size

name: Greater Swiss Mountain Dog
summary: Large, powerful, and striking tricolor working dog with distinctive tri-colored coat and gentle, dependable temperament. Known for strength and robust build as a draft dog.

name: Greek Shepherd
summary: Large, powerful livestock guardian dog native to the mountainous regions of Greece, known for its thick double coat, independent nature, and strong protective instincts developed over centuries of guarding flocks

name: Greenland Dog
summary: A powerful, heavy-built spitz-type dog of ancient origin with thick double coat, bred for endurance as a sled dog in harsh Arctic conditions. One of the world's oldest dog breeds with erect ears and a tail that curls over the back.

name: Himalayan Sheepdog
origin: Himalayan region of India and Nepal
summary: An ancient and powerful livestock guardian breed from the Himalayan region with formidable size, thick double coat, and fiercely protective instincts. Also known as the Gaddi Kutta, Bhote Kukur, or Himalayan Mastiff, this sturdy mountain dog was developed for herding and guarding livestock in harsh Himalayan conditions.

name: Hokkaido
summary: Medium-sized, athletic spitz-type hunting dog with thick double coat, prick ears, curled tail, and alert expression. Originally bred by the Ainu people for hunting large game in harsh climates of Hokkaido, Japan.

name: Hovawart
summary: Large, powerful working dog with a long, dense, slightly wavy coat and strong protective instincts, originally bred as a farmyard guardian but known for its balanced temperament as both devoted family companion and vigilant watchdog

name: Kamchatka Sled Dog
summary: An ancient, powerful landrace sled dog from Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula with a thick double coat and strong, athletic build. This large spitz-type breed was developed for endurance and work in harsh Arctic conditions, possessing a primitive appearance and resilient nature.

name: Kangal Shepherd Dog
summary: Large, powerful, and heavy-boned livestock guardian dog with distinctive fawn coat, black mask and ears, and curled tail, bred for protecting flocks from predators

name: Karakachan

Ears either prick or drop, both feathered
