name: Doxiepoo
summary: Small to medium designer crossbreed between a Dachshund and a Poodle, known for its variable appearance and intelligent, playful nature combining traits from both parent breeds

name: Eskapoo
summary: Small to medium designer breed combining the fluffy coat and friendly nature of the American Eskimo Dog with the intelligence and low-shedding curly coat of the Miniature Poodle

name: Foxhoodle
summary: A modern mixed breed cross between a Foxhound and Standard Poodle that combines the Poodle's trainability and potentially low-shedding coat with the Foxhound's stamina, scenting abilities, and pack mentality. Coat type and temperament can vary significantly depending on which parent's traits are more dominant.

name: Frenchton
summary: Small, compact crossbreed combining French Bulldog and Boston Terrier traits with distinctive bat ears, muscular build, and expressive features. Known for its sturdy build with a slightly longer snout than the French Bulldog parent.

name: Frug
summary: Small, charming companion crossbreed resulting from a cross between a French Bulldog and Pug, known for its playful personality, distinctive flat-faced (brachycephalic) appearance, and compact build

name: Gerberian Shepsky
summary: Large athletic mixed breed combining the loyalty and intelligence of the German Shepherd Dog with the endurance and striking appearance of the Siberian Husky. A powerful crossbreed with thick double coat and high energy, though characteristics can vary significantly depending on genetic inheritance.

name: German Sheprador
summary: Large, athletic crossbreed with sturdy build combining the intelligence and loyalty of German Shepherd with the friendly, outgoing retrieving nature of Labrador Retriever

name: Goberian
summary: Medium to large energetic crossbreed combining the Golden Retriever's friendly, affable nature with the Siberian Husky's striking looks and athleticism. Known for their intelligence, dense double coat, and friendly expression.

name: Golden Mountain Dog
summary: Large, friendly mixed breed combining the sociable, eager-to-please nature of the Golden Retriever with the sturdy frame, calm loyalty, and potential tri-color coat of the Bernese Mountain Dog

name: Gull Dong
summary: A large, powerful, and muscular mastiff-type dog from Pakistan, known for its formidable presence and strong protective instincts. Developed as a cross between the Gull Terrier and the Bully Kutta, this breed features a short, smooth coat and agile build designed for guarding and protection work.

name: Havapoo
summary: Small designer crossbreed between Havanese and Toy Poodle, known for its intelligent, affectionate personality and soft, low-shedding coat that ranges from wavy to curly

name: Huskimo
summary: Medium to large mixed breed combining Siberian Husky and American Eskimo Dog traits, featuring a wolf-like appearance with Spitz-type characteristics, thick double coat, and energetic, intelligent temperament

name: Irish Doodle
summary: Medium to large crossbreed combining the friendly, outgoing nature and athleticism of the Irish Setter with the intelligence and low-shedding, wavy or curly coat of the Standard Poodle

name: King Shepherd
summary: Large, robust shepherd-type dog developed as an improved German Shepherd with better health and temperament. Resembles a giant, heavy-boned German Shepherd with a plush or coarse double coat and calmer, more stable demeanor intended as a family companion and guardian.

name: Labraheeler
summary: Medium to large athletic crossbreed combining the loyal, hard-working nature of the Australian Cattle Dog with the friendly, outgoing temperament of the Labrador Retriever. This intelligent and energetic mixed breed features a short double coat and strong work ethic.

name: Labsky
summary: Medium to large energetic crossbreed combining Labrador Retriever and Siberian Husky traits, known for its athletic build, striking appearance, and friendly yet independent nature. Physical appearance and temperament can vary significantly between individuals.

name: Lhasapoo
summary: Small designer crossbreed between Lhasa Apso and Poodle, combining the intelligence and low-shedding coat of the Poodle with the loyal, alert nature of the Lhasa Apso. Features a fluffy, wavy or curly coat and affectionate, friendly temperament.

name: Lurcher
summary: Athletic, lean sighthound crossbreed combining speed, agility, and stamina, traditionally used for hunting and coursing. Known for versatility as a cross between sighthounds and pastoral or terrier breeds.

name: Maltipoo
summary: Small affectionate crossbreed between a Maltese and a Poodle, known for its soft, wavy or curly, low-shedding coat and playful companion nature

name: Maltshi
summary: Small designer crossbreed resulting from crossing a Maltese and Shih Tzu, known for their affectionate nature, low-shedding silky coat, and charming companion temperament

name: Mastidoodle
summary: Large crossbreed combining the gentle giant nature of the Mastiff with the intelligence and low-shedding coat of the Standard Poodle

name: Mojee
summary: Small companion crossbreed with uncertain parentage, possibly involving Japanese Chin crossed with either Maltese or Poodle. Not recognized by major kennel clubs, this modern designer breed typically displays a cheerful and affectionate temperament.

name: Mongrel
temperament: Variable depending on ancestry and individual traits
summary: Mixed breed dog of unknown or varied ancestry, combining traits from multiple breeds. Physical characteristics, temperament, and health are highly variable and unpredictable, though often display hybrid vigor.

name: Morkie
summary: Small mixed breed companion dog combining the gentle nature of the Maltese with the spirited personality of the Yorkshire Terrier. Known for its long, silky, low-shedding coat and toy-sized stature.

name: Newfypoo
summary: Large mixed breed cross between Newfoundland and Standard Poodle, combining the gentle, patient nature of the Newfoundland with Poodle intelligence and typically low-shedding coat qualities

name: Northern Inuit Dog
summary: Large, athletic, wolf-like dog developed in the UK to resemble wolves while maintaining a domestic temperament suitable for companionship. Known for intelligence and loyalty but also independent nature.

name: Papipoo
summary: Small designer crossbreed combining the Papillon's distinctive butterfly ears and alertness with the Toy Poodle's intelligence and low-shedding qualities, featuring a coat that ranges from straight and silky to wavy or curly

name: Peekapoo
summary: Small companion mixed breed with soft curled or wavy coat combining the Pekingese and Toy Poodle

name: Pekeapoo
summary: Small designer crossbreed combining Pekingese and Poodle traits, creating an intelligent and affectionate companion dog with a compact size and low-shedding coat

name: Pitsky
summary: A powerful and energetic mixed breed combining the athleticism and striking appearance of the Siberian Husky with the strength of the American Pit Bull Terrier, known for its athletic build and energetic temperament

name: Pomapoo
summary: A small designer crossbreed between a Pomeranian and Toy or Miniature Poodle, featuring a soft, fluffy coat and expressive face. This intelligent, affectionate companion dog often inherits the Poodle's low-shedding coat with a lively, adaptable personality.

name: Pomsky
summary: Designer crossbreed between Pomeranian and Siberian Husky with striking wolf-like appearance in a compact, manageable size. Features thick plush coat, fox-like face resembling a miniature Husky, with varied appearance and size depending on individual inheritance.

name: Poochon
summary: Small designer crossbreed combining Toy Poodle intelligence with Bichon Frisé cheerfulness, featuring a hypoallergenic curly coat and playful, affectionate personality

name: Pugapoo
summary: Small designer crossbreed combining Pug and Poodle traits, featuring a compact build with wavy or curly coat and lively, affectionate temperament. Appearance varies significantly depending on genetic inheritance from parent breeds.

name: Puggle
summary: Small to medium-sized mixed breed crossbreed between a Pug and Beagle, known for its wrinkled, hound-like face, sturdy body, and energetic, affectionate nature

name: Pyredoodle
summary: Large mixed breed created by crossing a Great Pyrenees and Standard Poodle, combining the Poodle's intelligence and low-shedding coat with the Great Pyrenees' calm, protective nature. Features a sturdy build with wavy or curly coat, though traits can vary significantly.

name: Ridgeypoo
summary: A large, athletic mixed breed created by crossing a Rhodesian Ridgeback with a Standard Poodle, combining the Poodle's intelligence and low-shedding coat with the Ridgeback's strength, loyalty, and distinctive athletic build

name: Rottle
summary: Large, athletic and intelligent mixed breed crossing the Rottweiler and Standard Poodle, combining the Rottweiler's protective nature and strength with the Poodle's intelligence and potentially low-shedding curly or wavy coat

name: Rottsky
summary: Large, athletic mixed breed with well-muscled build and thick double coat, combining the strength and loyalty of the Rottweiler with the endurance and independent spirit of the Siberian Husky. Physical appearance and temperament can vary significantly.

name: Saint Berdoodle
summary: Large and powerful mixed breed combining the gentle, patient nature of the Saint Bernard with the intelligence and often low-shedding coat of the Standard Poodle. Traits can vary significantly based on genetic inheritance, often featuring wavy or curly coats.

name: Schnoodle
summary: A crossbreed between a Poodle and a Schnauzer, combining intelligence, charming personality, and low-shedding coat. This mixed breed companion dog is known for its playful nature, with size and appearance varying significantly depending on the parent breeds used.

name: Scoodle
summary: Small to medium spirited crossbreed combining Scottish Terrier's bold, confident temperament with Poodle's intelligence and low-shedding coat. Features a sturdy build with wiry or curly coat and lively expression.

name: Sheepadoodle
summary: Large crossbreed combining the Old English Sheepdog's gentle herding nature with the Poodle's intelligence and low-shedding coat. Known for a shaggy coat and family-friendly disposition, with characteristics varying depending on genetic inheritance from parent breeds

name: Shih Poo
summary: Small designer crossbreed between Shih Tzu and Poodle with soft, wavy or curly coat and hypoallergenic potential. Known for friendly temperament and playful nature, though appearance and temperament can vary as a mixed breed.

name: Shorkie
summary: Small designer crossbreed combining Shih Tzu and Yorkshire Terrier traits, known for its big personality, silky coat, and spirited yet affectionate nature in a compact companion dog

name: Springerdoodle
summary: Medium to large crossbreed combining the English Springer Spaniel's athleticism and friendly sporting nature with the Poodle's intelligence and low-shedding coat. This energetic, versatile designer breed often has a curly coat and makes an excellent family companion.

name: Sprocker Spaniel
summary: A popular, highly energetic and intelligent crossbreed combining the Springer Spaniel and the Cocker Spaniel. Originally bred by gamekeepers for working and hunting, Sprockers have boundless stamina, exceptional agility, and a very friendly, loyal temperament.

name: Sprollie
summary: Medium to large energetic crossbreed between a Border Collie and English Springer Spaniel, known for its high intelligence, athleticism, work drive, and affectionate nature

name: Valley Bulldog
summary: Medium-sized, muscular crossbreed with a broad head and compact body, combining the stockiness of the English Bulldog with the athleticism of the Boxer. Features a brachycephalic (short-nosed) face and is known for its loyal, courageous temperament.

name: Vizsladoodle
summary: Medium to large active crossbreed combining the athletic ability and affectionate nature of the Hungarian Vizsla with the intelligence and low-shedding, curly coat of the Standard Poodle

name: Volkosob
summary: A large, powerful wolf-dog hybrid developed in Russia for military and border patrol duties, combining the physical attributes and enhanced senses of a wolf with the working ability of a German Shepherd. This experimental crossbreed features a robust build designed for specialized working applications.

name: Weimardoodle
summary: Large athletic crossbreed combining the Weimaraner's hunting instincts and noble appearance with the Poodle's intelligence and hypoallergenic coat. Features a wavy or curly coat and energetic, intelligent temperament.

name: Westiepoo
summary: Small crossbreed combining the spirited West Highland White Terrier with the intelligent Miniature Poodle, featuring a curly or wavy low-shedding coat, compact body, and lively temperament

name: Yorkipoo
summary: Small designer crossbreed between a Yorkshire Terrier and Toy or Miniature Poodle, known for its intelligent, spirited personality and low-shedding, variable coat type that can range from wavy to curly

name: Yorktese
summary: Small designer crossbreed combining Yorkshire Terrier and Maltese traits, known for its silky, low-shedding coat, spirited personality, and delicate build
